verdict.rationale: Attio's endpoint-reference docs say it exposes a public OpenAPI specification for its REST API at https://api.attio.com/openapi/api. That URL serves an OpenAPI 3.1.0 document titled 'Attio API' v2.0.0, with schemas for objects, records, lists and webhooks. The probe 404s only hit guessed paths on docs.attio.com, not the documented URL, so they do not contradict this. Missing for 10: independent or community hands-on corroboration of the spec's completeness and accuracy.
